written.headline: Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged Chinese spy
written.summary: Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, who U.S. officials allege is a Chinese spy. The board stated it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

written.headline: ByteDance considers data center expansion in Ceará, Brazil
written.summary: ByteDance is considering expanding its data center project in Ceará, Brazil, with a second phase that would be larger than its ongoing 300-megawatt project. The TikTok owner is looking for developers to build the expansion.

written.headline: CERT-In issues AI security auditing guidelines for autonomous systems
written.summary: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) released security auditing guidelines for artificial intelligence systems that independently execute tasks. The framework mandates checks for unauthorised tool use, privilege abuse, and emergency-stop mechanisms across four risk tiers.

written.headline: Trump says AI risks can be managed, signals openness to guardrails
written.summary: US President Donald Trump stated that artificial intelligence risks can be managed and expressed openness to safeguards. He told CBS’s “60 Minutes” that he does not mind guardrails, provided they do not place the United States behind China.

written.headline: Googlebook November update frees up 3GB-6GB of RAM via on-device AI optimizations
written.summary: Google released its November update for Googlebook OS, which frees up 3GB to 6GB of system RAM through on-device AI memory optimizations. The update also improves browser memory management and patches approximately 60 Android flaws.

written.headline: Top AI adopters in customer service gain over 50% KPI improvements: EY report
written.summary: According to an EY India report, organizations realizing the highest value from customer service AI reported over 50 percent improvements in core key performance indicators. However, overall business value generation remains uneven across enterprises.
